review.scope: Independent cross-layer review of full-graph placement editing, typed native recovery, render persistence, targeting and exact-package delivery.

correctedFindings.finding: Native P111 was previously treated as an unsupported property; its raw carrier is a numeric enum, not Boolean.
correctedFindings.resolution: Strict 0/1/2 decoding and raw source reprojection with explicit view resets; old unknown=0 and inactive Boolean test fixtures corrected, preserving all unrelated negative cases.

correctedFindings.finding: Base direct placement recovery lacked an explicit source-package version bound.
correctedFindings.resolution: Reader and second boundary require verified [11,0,0,0] for new direct/local P111 recovery; old complete true cache behavior remains unchanged.

correctedFindings.finding: Outline placement could be blocked by stale selected-cell state.
correctedFindings.resolution: Explicit Outline targets use their own root validation; real browser case proves placement and restore after cell selection.

correctedFindings.finding: Imported fit-to-content panel bounds still counted an unplaced child.
correctedFindings.resolution: Red regression reproduced 300x170; importer excludes placed:false and retains the existing 1x1 saved-schema minimum. Added raw child-carrier and placed-sibling cases.

review.historicalSourcePolicy: Authoring research cites pre-change source hashes; those are matched to the frozen prior audit, not falsely claimed as current source bytes.

limitations: Full Axure RP 11 reconstruction remains incomplete; this stage implements ordinary adaptive placement only.
Original editor canvas interactions and pixel equivalence remain unverified after the screenshot/input bridge failure.
None of the eleven original samples supplies direct/local P111 FALSE or IGNORE; positive raw-carrier cases are explicitly synthetic and not Axure-saved or Axure-accepted files.

Native placement recovery is restricted to verified RP11 direct MyStyle/local declarations; nontrue named/cache provider chains, special Layer/RDO/master propagation and contained descendants remain outside that subset.
The all-views control covers placement, insertion and deletion; general Affect All Views visual editing and clipboard adaptive-map migration remain incomplete.
Preserving mounted iframe identity is an implementation policy tested in the reconstruction; the original frame network lifecycle under Unplace has not been measured.
The document schema retains the existing minimum saved dimension of 1; a fit container with no placed content does not claim a native zero-sized saved rectangle.
Native RP write-back, complete cloud/team services, original device shell and full product parity remain unsupported.
